title: Mosaix Format Specification v1.2.1
description: Mosaix Format v1.2.1 includes MCP server enhancements (compose tool now supports three modes: text, structure, and file; UTF-8 encoding fix for Windows), Zenodo archival metadata, and multiagent integration guides. Based on v1.2.0 which introduced optional CORE keys (question, origin, as_of), graduated auditor exit codes, extensible entity types, and the Python library on PyPI (pip install mosaix-format) with CLI commands for checking, scaffolding, and migrating vaults.
